zh.name: 常见错误与替代做法
zh.summary: 每页指出一个具体失误，展示实际影响，再给能执行的替代方案。
zh.useWhen: 必须出现失误、后果、替代三项；个人省钱替代做法作为同一结构的经验变体。
zh.instructions: 具体场景、失误、后果证据、替代方案和实景照片
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Mistakes and Better Alternatives
en.summary: Create an Instagram list carousel using the mistakes and better alternatives structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the mistakes and better alternatives format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

imageCues: 封面上部白色紧包文字条写数量与错误，54–68px，下接较小说明
